description: More than 5 % of Forgejo's requests answered 5xx, on average over the last 5 minutes. Forgejo exports no traces; its router logs every finished request as 'router: completed <method> <path> for <peer>, <status> <text> in <time>'.

annotations.summary: share of Forgejo's requests that answered 5xx, in %

filter.expression: k8s.pod.name LIKE 'forgejo-%' AND body CONTAINS 'router: completed ' AND body REGEXP ', 5[0-9][0-9] [A-Z]'
k8s.pod.name LIKE 'forgejo-%' AND body CONTAINS 'router: completed '
